---
title: "check-r-package.yml"
---

Bundles the standard check suite for R package repositories
(such as [`Morrison-Lab/rpt`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/rpt)).
Replaces individual hygiene and R code review checks
with a single composite action or reusable workflow call.

## What it runs

Runs the full Morrison-Lab repository hygiene pass
plus R package-specific checks:

- [`check-junk-files.yml`](check-junk-files.qmd):
  OS and editor detritus (`.DS_Store`, `Thumbs.db`, `.Rhistory`, etc.)
- [`check-secrets.yml`](check-secrets.qmd):
  Gitleaks scan of git history for committed credentials and tokens
- [`check-non-standard-chars.yml`](check-non-standard-chars.qmd):
  flags non-standard unicode characters, curly quotes, and smart dashes
- [`check-new-line-breaks.yml`](check-new-line-breaks.qmd):
  enforces semantic line breaks on modified lines in diffs
- [`check-typos.yml`](check-typos.qmd):
  crate-ci/typos CLI scan for spelling errors on modified files
- [`check-ai-tells.yml`](check-ai-tells.qmd):
  scans narrative prose (`*.md`, `*.Rmd`, `*.qmd`) for AI cliches and tells
- [`lint-yaml.yml`](lint-yaml.qmd):
  yamllint over tracked YAML files
- [`lint-workflows.yml`](lint-workflows.qmd):
  actionlint and zizmor over GitHub Actions workflows
- [`lint-markdown.yml`](lint-markdown.qmd):
  markdownlint-cli2 over tracked Markdown files
- [`check-duplicate-roxygen.yml`](check-duplicate-roxygen.qmd):
  detects duplicated `@param` documentation across `R/` files
- [`check-one-function-per-file.yml`](check-one-function-per-file.qmd):
  enforces single function definition per file in `R/`
- [`check-formatting.yml`](check-formatting.qmd):
  verifies R code formatting via Air (`posit-dev/setup-air`)
- [`check-extra.yml`](check-extra.qmd):
  runs extra checks (warnings as errors, readme freshness) when opt-in

Every check is enabled by default (except `check-extra`, which is opt-in).
Opt out of any specific check by passing its boolean flag as `false`.

PR metadata governance workflows that inspect pull request labels
([`check-news.yml`](check-news.qmd), [`version-check.yml`](version-check.qmd))
remain dedicated standalone workflows because they require
`pull-requests: read` permissions to inspect live labels from the GitHub API.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fail` | boolean | `true` | Fail the job on findings (else warn only). |
| `check-junk-files` | boolean | `true` | Enable junk files check. |
| `junk-patterns` | string | see `check-junk-files.qmd` | Gitignore patterns naming junk files. |
| `junk-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Paths to exempt from junk files scan. |
| `check-secrets` | boolean | `true` | Enable gitleaks secrets scan. |
| `secrets-config` | string | `''` | Custom gitleaks config file path. |
| `secrets-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Regex paths to exempt from secrets scan. |
| `check-non-standard-chars` | boolean | `true` | Enable non-standard character check. |
| `non-standard-chars-extensions` | string | `'.R, .qmd, .md'` | File extensions to check for non-standard characters. |
| `check-new-line-breaks` | boolean | `true` | Enable semantic line break check. |
| `new-line-breaks-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for diff-scoping new line breaks. |
| `new-line-breaks-globs` | string | `''` | Globs to check for new line breaks. |
| `check-typos` | boolean | `true` | Enable typos check. |
| `typos-config` | string | `''` | Typos configuration file path. |
| `typos-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for diff-scoping typo checks. |
| `check-ai-tells` | boolean | `true` | Enable AI tells check on prose. |
| `ai-tells-threshold` | string | `'10'` | Maximum allowed tell density (per 1,000 words). |
| `ai-tells-ignore` | string | `''` | Comma- or space-separated list of tells to ignore. |
| `lint-yaml` | boolean | `true` | Enable YAML linting. |
| `yaml-config-file` | string | `''` | Custom yamllint config file path. |
| `yaml-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Patterns to exclude from YAML linting. |
| `lint-workflows` | boolean | `true` | Enable workflow linting. |
| `workflows-path` | string | `'.'` | Path to workflow files. |
| `lint-markdown` | boolean | `true` | Enable Markdown linting. |
| `markdown-config-file` | string | `''` | Markdownlint config file path. |
| `markdown-globs` | string | `'*.md'` | Git pathspecs of Markdown files to lint. |
| `markdown-paths-ignore` | string | `''` | Paths to exempt from Markdown linting. |
| `markdown-base-ref` | string | `''` | Base ref for list-item splice checks. |
| `check-duplicate-roxygen` | boolean | `true` | Enable duplicate roxygen documentation check. |
| `duplicate-roxygen-path` | string | `'.'` | Directory path to scan for duplicate roxygen docs. |
| `check-one-function-per-file` | boolean | `true` | Enforce one function per file in `R/`. |
| `one-function-per-file-path` | string | `'R'` | Path to R directory. |
| `check-extra` | boolean | `false` | Run extra R checks (`warnings`, `random-order`, `readme`). |
| `extra-check` | string | `'warnings'` | Extra check type to run. |
| `check-formatting` | boolean | `true` | Enable Air R code formatting check. |
| `air-version` | string | `'0.11.0'` | Air release version to install. |
| `air-path` | string | `'.'` | Path to format-check. |

## Example

```yaml
name: Check R package

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  check:
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/check-r-package.yml@v2
```
